_comment: Single source of truth for the models the repo's own tooling calls.
Never hardcode an id in a workflow: free-tier ids are rotated and
deprecated without notice, so a pinned id eventually 404s. A 404 must
land in the same bucket as a timeout -- the caller abstains and uses its
fallback -- because 'the model we named no longer exists' must never read
These three are on DIFFERENT endpoint families. Only `categorize` speaks
neither appears in GET /api/v1/models, which lists chat models only.
`rerank` has a 10,240-token context -- 13x smaller than the embedder and
~100x smaller than the categorizer. Chunk rerank inputs; do not assume one
/review does NOT read this file. Its model is the ORG variable
`OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_FREE_MODEL`, so every repo in the org rotates together
when a free id is retired. Two places naming one model is the failure this
file exists to prevent, so it is named once, there, and pointed at here.
